描述_ZN: The Seven Rhythmic Poems" scroll, Ming, inscribed by Xu Wei, on paper, standing scroll, 163.7 cm long and 43 cm wide. Cursive script, 4 lines.　　This scroll contains one poem in seven lines, which can be found in the collection of Xu Wei.　　The poem reads: "The court has long dismissed the filial incorruptible section, and only the ruler's carriage is not enough. The tomb road must be engraved with stones, and the door is finally closed to see the abandoned fine silk. The sun sets a thousand miles from my heart, and the snow is so lonely that I can see the two foxholes. This life in Pengcheng is only ten days, do not teach to make the next ice slope. The father of Zisui arrived in Yan because of the tomb of the venerable person, and returned at the end of the year. Xu Wei, a native of Tianchi Mountain." 　　Inscriptions of four seals: "Shanyin Buyi", "Shuxian", "Jinbei Shanren" and "Bazhari Bazhari Bazhari Ren". The first seal of the welcome is "Gongsun Daniang". The collection seal is inscribed with "Shen Sheng Zhen Appreciation" and "Li".　　This scroll of "Seven Rhythmic Poems" is characterized by a smooth and sharp brushwork, a dense and vigorous layout, and an unrestrained and open brushwork, which resembles a running snake and a vicious snake, and is full of clouds and smoke on the paper.
